title: The Ambassadors (You Cannot See Both)
summary: An anamorphic skull that resolves only at a grazing tilt, where the two ambassadors dissolve — no single view holds both.
mechanism: CSS perspective + rotateX foreshortening compresses a vertically pre-stretched canvas skull into true proportion only at the grazing angle where the face-on figures collapse, making the two readings geometrically mutually exclusive.
references: Hans Holbein the Younger, The Ambassadors (1533)
